title: Chat or Voice per conversation, as in ChatGPT's app: the header's mode menu (Chat checked, Voice) and the chat box's audio wave go into a voice view (an orb) that replaces the conversation's body, with a footer (mute, X) in the chat box's place; X, Chat or another tab go back and end the voice
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout (dependencies installed, a Chrome or Playwright Chromium available) run: node --test --test-timeout=120000 packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/e2e/voice-mode.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/voice-mode-view.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: 'Chat or Voice: Voice takes the body and the chat box, listens, sends, works out loud, reads the reply, stops for the person; X back to Chat' passes: the menu has Chat checked and Voice; in Voice the orb view is shown, there is no chat box (no draft) and the footer has mute and X; mute pauses the ear; X goes back to Chat where the spoken requests are the person's messages.

'into Voice from the chat box, out by another tab; dark; a narrow column' passes: the audio wave in the chat box goes into Voice, another tab ends the voice and brings the chat box back, the menu stays on screen at 390px and nothing scrolls sideways.
'the tab is pressed once the strip renders, never when already shown, and given up on after a while' passes.
evidence: 16/10/2026: (translated) 'each session gets 2 options, 1 voice, 2 chat, like the ChatGPT app on a phone' (screenshot of ChatGPT's voice screen: an orb, mute, X). Screenshots and the real dsh page: tasks/evidence/voice-chat-or-voice-2026-10-16/.
fence: ModeMenu, VoiceModeView (ends the voice when it leaves the screen), VoiceModeFooter in packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/src/client/VoiceMode.tsx; pressViewTab/shownSessions in voice-mode-view.mjs; the conversation.view, view definition and conversation.composer registrations in index.tsx

tests: Chat or Voice: Voice takes the body and the chat box, listens, sends, works out loud, reads the reply, stops for the person; X back to Chat
into Voice from the chat box, out by another tab; dark; a narrow column
the tab is pressed once the strip renders, never when already shown, and given up on after a while
